name: Mana Conduit
notes: The percentage determines one total mana amount, divided equally between the other player characters. Uses mana actually lost to incoming damage. Spending mana on skills does not trigger this effect.
summary: When damage makes you lose mana, restore a percentage of that lost mana to your teammates, split evenly among them.
